builds.hypothesis: Q5 maximum-distance is3.25*(150+0.5AP)=487.5+1.625AP magic. AP/MR penetration exploit capped distance multiplier. Deathcap multiplies AP; earned Seraph supplies mana and observed Awe AP. Zhonya/Banshee each add105AP. Void provides40% MR penetration; Shadowflame provides15 flat MR penetration and20% eligible low-health magic amplification. 30min Gathering Storm adaptive stats fixed; Absolute Focus requires ownerabove70%HP. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

kitEvidence.formula: Human Form: Nidalee throws her javelin, dealing [70 / 90 / 110 / 130 / 150 + (0.5) × AP] magic damage, increased up to [(70 / 90 / 110 / 130 / 150 + (0.5) × AP) × (3.25)] magic damage based on distance flown.

builds.name: Takedown: hunted cougar finisher
builds.summary: Explore a high hunted cougar Takedown result with finite setup and controlled one-item swaps. This is an experiment, not a certified optimum.
builds.goal: Explore a high hunted cougar Takedown result with finite setup and controlled one-item swaps. This is an experiment, not a certified optimum.
builds.hypothesis: Cougar Takedown uses the Aspect of the Cougar helper: at R rank 4 its base is 80 + 0.75 total AD + 0.4 AP, increased with target missing health and by 30% when Hunted. The wrapper's exact missing-health factor must be read in the current client. This is magic damage despite the AD ratio; compare flat AD against AP/MR modifiers.
